stages.name: Salvage over the hazard
stages.law: objective law, measured at the newest physical sample: HELD only while the engine's step counter advances (paused or step-stalled polls show a stale chip, not a ruling); the crate's COM is inside the marked region x 0.54..0.70 m, -0.05..+0.05 m, and every corner of the crate box (50 x 25 x 25 mm half-extents about the COM, rotated by the crate's live pose) whose x/z projects inside the pad-top footprint x 0.48..0.76 m, z -0.08..+0.08 m sits >= 4 mm above the live slab top (corners projecting outside the footprint do not count; mild tilt is legal); supports may stand on the pad — only the crate's own corners are judged here, until gap row 4 decides otherwise; the continuity window is the declared 20000-substep step span (5 s physical at dt_substep 0.00025); the load path is the admitted contact/weld physics only
stages.falsifier: a crate corner resting at/below the slab top at settle (on the hazard) or COM out of the region; rejected edits moving the hash
stages.cell: Scene booting: the granite slab is the MARKED HAZARD REGION. Kit: granite pier x2, timber deck, granite pillar, steel crate.
